main_text.p: ētis[?] vel gnomis: πάντα ἰδὼν Διὸς ὀφθαλμὸς ἡ πάν-τα νοήσας[?], &c.
Obiectio 1. Eventus fuit contrarius commi-natio[?]ni. Ergo, &c.

Respon. Negetur antecedens: 1. quia commi-natio fuit conditionalis: Delebo : nisi tu inter-cesseris. 2. Fuit in determinata tempore. Precibus igitur Mosis pœna fuit dilata non sublata. Textus v. 34. In die visitationis meæ tunc visitabo, &c.
Obiectio 2. Deum pœnituit: afferantur quæ-dam similia loca Gen.6.1. Sam.15. Ionæ 3.Ier. 19.

Resp. ἀνθρωποπαθῶς non mutatione consilii, sed mutatione aut dilatione eventus: quæ certa fuit in mente Dei, & subintellecta in commina-tione ad tacitam conditionem precum, Ostenda-tur idem in similibus locis.

Conclusio 1. Precibus non mutatur quidem Deus, sed pœnæ tamen vel mitigantur vel differuntur vel avertuntur. 2. Ad comminationes igitur divinas non oportet desperare, sed ardeter[?] orare & agere pœnitentiam.

page.notes: The first line's opening word is uncertain (ētis or similar). The Greek in the first line and in "ἀνθρωποπαθῶς" is read from a small, faint print and may contain errors; the Greek of the first line's final word is doubtful. "ardeter" may be a printing error for "ardenter". The large initial E of "EXordium" is joined to the word as the printer set it. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible at the right and is not transcribed.
